title: Wargames.MY CTF 2023
description:
Wargames.MY CTF is back for 2023!  As usual, the 24-hours Jeopardy CTF will be running the whole day on a December Saturday (GMT+8), max 3 players per team.

Official website: https://wargames.my
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/6Q95FjHCcM

Categories: Web, Reverse, Crypto, Forensics, Pwn, Ppc, Misc

Huge thanks to our sponsors for making this happen:
- NetByteSec: https://www.netbytesec.com/
- ASK-Pentest: https://www.ask-pentest.com/
- Fenrir Solution: https://fenrirsolution.com/
- REHACK: https://www.rehack.xyz/

CTF Ended, feel free to submit write-ups.
prizes:
A total prize pool of 6000 MYR split between the top 3 of each category. Plus an array of limited edition swags!

Swags include: T-shirt, Medal, Enamel Badge, Lanyard, Mousepad, and Stickers!

*Only Malaysia citizens are eligible for the cash prizes, but we will still ship the exclusive swags to you :D
